info.name: OmniWallet sandbox discovery (read-only)
info.description: Official OmniWallet read-only sandbox examples. All requests use GET. Status needs no key; currency requests require your own sandbox API key in your local Postman Vault. No real credential values or customer responses are included. No payments, payouts or account mutations. Reference: https://omniwallet.ewin888.com/docs/api/ . The public sandbox status endpoint was checked; authenticated requests have not been executed with merchant credentials.

request.description: Requires a locally stored sandbox API key. Lists platform currency codes; this does not establish merchant eligibility.
Requires a locally stored sandbox API key. Confirm chain and contract; do not infer support from token name alone.
